idea: Own TQQQ only in the middle of the FOMC intermeeting period; BIL during the post-decision unwind and the late pre-meeting de-risking.
hypothesis: The equity risk premium is earned in the ~3 weeks after the two-day post-FOMC positioning unwind; the immediate post-decision and late pre-meeting phases are flat or negative.
